name: Watermelon Downy Mildew
description: A destructive foliar disease of watermelon causing angular yellow lesions on leaves. It spreads rapidly in humid conditions and can defoliate entire fields within days.
symptoms: Angular yellow to light green lesions on upper leaf surfaces
Purple-gray fuzzy growth on corresponding lower leaf surfaces
Lesions turning brown and necrotic with age
Poor fruit development due to loss of foliage
treatments: Apply fungicides containing metalaxyl or mancozeb at first symptoms
Spray chlorothalonil at 7-day intervals during favorable conditions
Alternate fungicide classes to prevent resistance
prevention: Plant resistant or tolerant watermelon varieties
Maintain adequate plant spacing for ventilation
